result.rationale: The diff verifiably changes GET /groups/:group_id/members from rendering a bare serialized array (`render_serialized(members.to_a, GroupUserSerializer)`) to `render json: { members: ..., meta: ... }`. In-repo consumers (group.js findMembers, group-members route/template) are updated in the same diff, but the response shape change is an unversioned breaking change for out-of-tree consumers (plugins, API scripts). This is not itself a defect in the new code's behavior, but a concrete, diff-grounded migration/compatibility risk a maintainer should weigh when shipping.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `GroupsController#members` from `render_serialized(members.to_a, GroupUserSerializer)` (a bare JSON array) to `render json: { members: ..., meta: ... }` (an object wrapper) and also changes the client to call `/groups/:name/members.json` and iterate `{{#each m in members}}`. This is a backwards-incompatible change to a public GET endpoint response shape with no compatibility layer shown in the diff, so out-of-tree consumers expecting an array would break after deploy.
